parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The project authorization ID.
You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
项目授权ID。
您可以调用ListProjectAuthorizations接口获取该参数
parameters.name: authorization_id

fields.help_en: When PrincipalType is set to RamUser, specify the ID of the RAM user to be designated as the project administrator. When PrincipalType is set to RamRole, specify the ARN of the RAM role to be designated as the project administrator
fields.help_zh: 当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamUser 时，传入需要指定为项目管理员的 RAM 用户 ID。当 PrincipalType 取值为 RamRole 时，传入需要指定为项目管理员的 RAM 角色 ARN
fields.name: principal_id

fields.help_en: The display name of the RAM user or RAM role designated as the project administrator
fields.help_zh: 指定为项目管理员的 RAM 用户/RAM 角色显示名称
fields.name: principal_name

fields.help_en:
The type of the project administrator. Valid values:

RamUser: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

RamRole: RAM role
fields.help_zh:
项目管理员类型。取值：

RamUser：RAM用户。

RamRole：RAM角色
fields.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the project administrators specified in the project authorization
parameters.help_zh: 项目授权中指定的项目管理员信息
parameters.name: principals

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
